issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Water Fund column 26,296.05
issues.issue: Water Fund receipts are printed only as 'Local Receipts: Other'; treating them as water charges is an assumption (review note present). If they are water sales, the user's 2026-10-28 rule puts utility fund sales/charges in the 'Utility Charges' category rather than charges for services/fees.
